Your holdings: SOXL (-50.07%) and SPAL (-30.26%) are flagged for attention. These leveraged ETFs are bleeding and amplify margin calls.

Watch: Keep an eye on oil prices and any geopolitical escalation.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the broader market sentiment driven by oil.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting if it breaks below its current price, given the -50% PnL and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or exiting if the price continues to fall, given the -30% PnL and leveraged nature.
